## Authority and coverage boundary

Original findings and source statuses remain in the [historical register](../00-governance/technical-validation.md#research-assessment-baseline). Current metadata comes from `validation/register/validations/`. Mapping identifies investigations; it does not establish completed tests or acceptance. The [methodology](methodology.md) explains those gates.

The initial proposal named 29 distinct experiments while stating 30. EXP-004 remains unallocated; EXP-001–EXP-003 and EXP-005–EXP-030 retain their assigned identities. Shared experiments declare narrower test applicability explicitly.
